permissions.flags_manage: Turn feature flags on or off and manage testers

layout.footer: You receive this email because you have an account with BEAM Vitality Center.
layout.button_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

magic_link.subject: Your sign-in link for BEAM
magic_link.preheader: Sign in with one click. The link is valid for {expiresMinutes} minutes.
magic_link.heading: Sign in to your BEAM account
magic_link.body: Click the button below to sign in. The link is valid for {expiresMinutes} minutes and works only once. If you did not ask for this link, you can ignore this email.

staff_invite.subject: You are invited to the BEAM back-office
staff_invite.heading: Welcome to the BEAM team
staff_invite.body: An account has been created for you in the BEAM back-office. Choose a password and set up two-step verification. The link is valid for {expiresHours} hours and works only once.

password_reset.subject: Reset your BEAM password
password_reset.preheader: The link is valid for {expiresMinutes} minutes.
password_reset.heading: Choose a new password
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to choose a new one. The link is valid for {expiresMinutes} minutes. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email: your password stays the same.

mfa_changed.subject: A security setting of your BEAM account changed
mfa_changed.heading: Security notice
mfa_changed.body: {change, select, password_changed {Your password was changed.} password_reset {Your password was reset.} mfa_reset {Two-step verification was reset for your account.} recovery_codes_regenerated {New recovery codes were created for your account.} other {A security setting of your account was changed.}} If this was not you, contact your administrator immediately.

monthly_report.subject: BEAM platform report {period}
monthly_report.heading: Monthly platform report
monthly_report.body: Here are the figures of the BEAM platform for {period}: availability, incidents, support requests, backups and AI use.

report.title: Report a problem
report.description: Tell us what went wrong. We answer within the support hours of your severity.
report.critical_example: Nobody can book or pay, or the site is down.
report.high_example: An important feature fails for some people.
report.normal_example: Something is wrong but there is a workaround.
report.improvement_example: An idea or a small change you would like.

login.title: Sign in to the BEAM back-office
login.intro: Use your work email address and password. You will then enter a code from your authenticator app.
login.invalid_credentials: Email address or password is incorrect
login.rate_limited: Too many attempts, try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

mfa.setup_intro: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manual_key: Or enter this key by hand
mfa.verify_intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for BEAM.
mfa.invalid_code: This code is not valid. Try the next code.
mfa.recovery_codes_intro: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.

invite.title: Choose your password
invite.intro: Welcome to BEAM. Choose a password; next you set up two-step verification.
invite.invalid: This invitation is no longer valid; ask an administrator to resend it.

reset.request_intro: Enter your work email address. We send you a link that works for one hour.
reset.sent: If the address is known we sent a link.
reset.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

password.hint: At least {min} characters. Avoid common words and your email address.
password.breached: This password appeared in a data breach
password.too_weak: The password is too easy to guess.
password.same_as_email: The password may not be your email address.

account.title: My account
account.name: Name
account.password_changed: Your password was changed. Other devices were signed out.
account.wrong_password: The current password is not correct.
account.regenerate_intro: Enter a code from your authenticator app to create 10 new recovery codes. The old codes stop working.
account.sign_out_others: Sign out on all other devices
account.signed_out_others: Signed out on {count, plural, one {# other device} other {# other devices}}.

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.intro: Jobs that failed for good are dead. Retry one after fixing the cause, or discard it with a reason.
jobs.timeline_empty: This job made no provider calls.
jobs.not_dead: Only dead jobs can be retried or discarded.

portal_login.title: Sign in to your BEAM account
portal_login.intro: Enter your email address and we send you a sign-in link. No password needed.
portal_login.invalid_credentials: Email address or password is incorrect
portal_login.rate_limited: Too many attempts, try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
portal_login.check_body: Check your inbox; the link works for 15 minutes.
portal_login.resent: If the address is valid, a new link is on its way.
portal_login.error_body: Sign-in links work once and for 15 minutes. Request a new one below.
portal_login.error_staff: This address belongs to a staff account. Use a different address.
portal_login.error_denied: You cannot sign in with this account. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.

portal_security.title: Security
portal_security.intro: You can always sign in with an email link. A password is optional.
portal_security.sign_out_all: Sign out on all other devices

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Accounts, roles, feature flags and the settings of every module.
settings.card_users_description: Invite colleagues, change their role, reset MFA.
settings.card_roles_description: Which permissions each of the nine roles holds.
settings.card_flags_description: Switch features on for testers or for everyone.
settings.card_ai_description: Budget, daily cap, model prices and sensitive processing.
settings.card_company_description: Legal name, VAT number, address and contact details.

ai_settings.title: AI settings
ai_settings.intro: The monthly budget, the daily cap on calls and the model prices used to compute costs.
ai_settings.sensitive_intro: Off by default. Switching it on needs the owner, a purpose, a DPIA reference and an approved DPIA. No current AI feature receives sensitive data.
ai_settings.purpose_hint: At least 20 characters: why sensitive data is needed.
ai_settings.sensitive_owner_only: Only an owner can switch this on.

users.title: Staff users
users.intro: Everyone who signs in to the back-office, with role, MFA and status.
users.empty: No staff users yet. Invite the first one.
users.name: Name
users.tester: Tester (sees features that are on for testers)
users.role_change_hint: Changing the role signs the user out everywhere.
users.disabled_done: The account is disabled and signed out.
users.mfa_reset_done: MFA was reset. The user sets it up again at the next sign-in.
users.no_audit: No audit entries about this user yet.
users.open_audit: Open the full audit log for this user

role_editor.title: Roles
role_editor.intro: The nine roles, how many active users hold each one and how many permissions it has.
role_editor.unknown_warning: Some roles hold permissions that no longer exist. They are ignored until you save the role again.
role_editor.owner_read_only: The owner role always holds every permission, also the ones added later.
role_editor.edit_intro: Tick the permissions of this role. Changes apply at the user's next request.
role_editor.confirm_description: Users with this role get the new permissions at their next request.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.intro: Switch a feature off, on for testers only, or on for everyone. Changes apply within a minute.
flags.person_ids_hint: One person id per line; the person search is not available yet.
flags.tester_counts: {users} staff and {persons} customers test this flag.

system.title: System
system.intro: The state of the platform at a glance. Refreshes every 30 seconds.
system.minutes_ago: {n, plural, =0 {Just now} one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
system.dead_jobs: {count, plural, =0 {No dead jobs} one {# dead job} other {# dead jobs}}
system.no_calls: No calls in the last 24 hours.
system.errors: {count, plural, =0 {no errors} one {# error} other {# errors}}

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Events received from providers and the job that processed each one.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: Health per provider over the last 24 hours and the latest 200 calls.

integrations.errors_24h: {count, plural, =0 {No errors} one {# error} other {# errors}}

audit.intro: Every change made by staff, jobs and the system. Values of secret fields are hidden.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

incidents.title: Security incidents
incidents.intro: The incident register: discovery, systems and data affected, risk, actions, notifications and resolution.
incidents.note_hint: Required when you reopen a resolved incident.
incidents.notified_hint: BEAM must be informed within 24 hours of discovery.
incidents.no_customer_names: Do not write customer names or health data here; use ids.

go_live.title: Go-live gate
go_live.intro: Production starts only when all 13 items are confirmed by an owner or technical administrator, each with a note.
go_live.view_only: Only an owner or technical administrator can confirm items.
go_live.item_ai_no_training_confirmed: AI provider does not train on our data
go_live.item_security_confirmed: Security test passed (pentest within 30 days, no open high incident)

security.title: Security
security.intro: Encryption keys, MFA coverage, locked accounts, backups, restore drills and ethical-hacking tests.
security.rows_behind: {count, plural, one {# row uses} other {# rows use}} an older key.
security.summary_hint: At least 10 characters. The full report stays in BEAM's shared drive.
security.pentest_saved: The test was recorded; the next one is due in 92 days.
security.rekey_intro: Re-encrypts every sensitive row with key version {version}, in the background.
security.rekey_confirm: I added SENSITIVE_DATA_KEY_V{version} to the environment

ai_usage.title: AI usage
ai_usage.intro: Which AI features exist, what they send and keep, and what they cost this month.

support.mine_intro: The problems you reported and how far they are.
support.empty_mine: You have not reported any problems.

support.note_hint: Required when you mark the request as responded; it is added to the description with the time.
support.log_title: Log a request received outside the app

reports.title: Monthly reports
reports.intro: The SLA report of each month: uptime, incidents, support, jobs, backups, AI and sizes.
reports.empty: The first report is created on the 1st of next month.
reports.manual_uptime_hint: Only when Better Stack could not be reached.
